location.title: Location
location.description: One city, region, or country to search. Include the country name when the location could be ambiguous.

keywords.title: Restaurant search keywords
keywords.description: Plain-language search phrases for healthy-focused restaurants. The default list is suitable for a first run.

maxRestaurants.title: Maximum restaurants
maxRestaurants.description: Maximum number of unique restaurants returned after discovery deduplication.

includeMenu.title: Include menu discovery
includeMenu.description: When enabled, Phase 3 crawls official restaurant homepages and discovers menu URLs without fetching or parsing menu contents.

normalizedOutputLanguage.title: Normalized output language
normalizedOutputLanguage.description: Language used for normalized taxonomy and output labels. Version 1 supports English.

preserveOriginalText.title: Preserve original text
preserveOriginalText.description: Keep source-language restaurant and menu text alongside normalized values.

maxMenuPagesPerRestaurant.title: Maximum menu pages per restaurant
maxMenuPagesPerRestaurant.description: Hard cap for scored menu URL candidates retained from each official homepage; menu contents are not fetched in Phase 3.

maxMenuItemsPerRestaurant.title: Maximum menu items per restaurant
maxMenuItemsPerRestaurant.description: Hard cap for nested menu items stored for each restaurant.
